sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: PCT Patent Application and International Trademark Registration

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman - national jurisdiction (unitary; no sub-state commercial registers)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: civil-law commercial code on the Egyptian model with Sharia as a constitutional source of legislation; unitary national regime; no sub-state tax or registration distinctions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: GCC Common Market (2008) - full establishment and cross-border services for GCC investors
Oman-US Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 January 2009)
Oman-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (1995; UK post-Brexit rollover treatment applies)
Arab League Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital in the Arab States (1980)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree 30/2016 (AML/CFT Law), as amended by Royal Decree 24/2020; Royal Decree 52/2019 (Regulation of Beneficial Ownership); MoCIIP Implementing Decision 55/2019 on the UBO register; Royal Decree 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law) Articles 9-14 (Single Person Company) and its Executive Regulations (Ministerial Decision 551/2020); NCFI guidance applicable to DNFBPs; FATF Recommendations 10, 12, 22, 24 and 25
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (MoCIIP UBO register; not publicly searchable; access restricted to competent authorities and Omani anti-corruption agencies under RD 52/2019)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (bio-data page) of the natural-person sole shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing national passport authority; notarized by a public notary in the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille certificate issued by the competent authority of the document's state of origin (Oman recognizes apostilles for contracting states; non-contracting states require consular legalization chain via the Embassy of Oman)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law (Sultani Decree No. 18/2019), as amended – Single Person Company provisions and applicable corporate governance sections; Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 29/2019); Commercial Registry Executive Regulations
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Companies Affairs Directorate and Commercial Registrar, Muscat (via Invest Easy portal)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Application (Invest Easy Form) together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (MAA)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Omani law does not prescribe a statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Foreign-Owned Single Person Company. The issued capital must be fully subscribed and paid in at incorporation as stated in the MAA, and deposited in a bank account opened for the company; no separate escrow account is required unless the activity-specific regulator imposes such a condition.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
AT THE FIRST MEETING of the Board of Managers of [Company Name] SPC held at the registered office on [date], the following resolutions were unanimously adopted:
1. RESOLVED, that the sole shareholder’s entire issued share capital as set out in the Memorandum and Articles of Association be taken up and recorded, and that the authorised representative complete all statutory incorporation filings.
2. RESOLVED, that the registered office address at [Muscat address] be adopted and filed with the Commercial Registry.
3. RESOLVED, that [Manager’s Name] be appointed Manager, with authority to operate bank accounts, execute agreements, and conduct all corporate, IP and licensing procedures under the Commercial Companies Law, effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into Invest Easy, initiate a new company formation transaction, search the trade name register, submit a name reservation request for a name ending with '(SPC) LLC', pay the electronic reservation fee and download the reservation certificate which is valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport of the sole foreign shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar to an existing mark, file an alternative name immediately through the same portal; a request for administrative review may be escalated to the MoCIIP Customer Service Directorate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Omani notary public / legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage an Omani licensed corporate lawyer to draft the MAA in Arabic (with English translation), reflecting the SPC structure, foreign ownership, share capital, registered office and manager appointments. The shareholder must execute the MAA before a licensed notary, after which the notary submits it for authentication in accordance with Ministry of Justice requirements.
required_dossiers: Passport copy and evidence of authority of the corporate representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or registrar raises a deficiency, amend the MAA provisions by mutual consent, re-execute before the notary and resubmit; any rejected statutory registration is curable by correction and payment of the required resubmission fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP – Companies Affairs Directorate / Commercial Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation application via Invest Easy, attaching the notarised MAA, name certificate and proof of registered office. The registrar will review the application, approve the incorporation and issue the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate with the Oman Commercial Registration Number.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or title deed for the Oman registered office
Passport copies of all shareholders and managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond through Invest Easy within the statutory correction period; if the query concerns the registered office, replace the lease evidence and resubmit. Administrative refusal may be challenged before the competent administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the CR, use the Invest Easy interoperability link to register the company as an OCCI member; pay the membership contribution and download the membership certificate which is required for certain commercial documents and municipal licences.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OCCI membership is delayed, present the CR certificate and request activation via the Invest Easy service desk; unresolved delays can be lodged as a formal service complaint with MoCIIP.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) and Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the tax registration application on the OTA online system to obtain the Tax Identification Number (TIN) and, where applicable, VAT registration; simultaneously register as an employer with PASI for Omani employee social insurance compliance.
required_dossiers: Shareholder information and Oman bank account details
Employment data for any intended employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA or PASI rejects registration, submit the required missing documents through the official e-services; penalties are avoided by proving submission within the statutory window and proactively responding to deficiency notices.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining the Activity-Specific License and Physical Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP – Directorate General of Intellectual Property; municipal and Civil Defence authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply through the integrated licensing service in Invest Easy for the professional commercial license covering PCT patent prosecution and trademark registration. Attach the qualifications of the responsible patent attorney and the municipal physical clearance of the office. Obtain Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) clearance for fire safety and complete any required workplace safety registration.
required_dossiers: Professional qualification certificates and CV of the patent agent/attorney
Office lease and municipal no-objection certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licence is delayed due to missing professional credentials, engage a licensed local patent attorney and amend the application; if physical clearance is refused, rectify fire safety or structural deficiencies and arrange reinspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: MoCIIP – Directorate General of Intellectual Property (Oman Patent and Trademark Office)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Professional License for Intellectual Property Representation and Patent Prosecution (Commercial Activity ISIC 7490)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (EA) of the Sultanate of Oman
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Non-industrial office activity; no EIA required for a professional services office with no manufacturing process.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for manufacturing effluent or volatile organic compound emissions; office sanitation must discharge to approved public sewer/drainage, and solid non-hazardous office waste must be handled by licensed municipal collectors in accordance with Oman’s waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) fire safety certificate for the premises, municipal structural/load safety clearance for the office rental unit, and a workplace occupational safety record confirming first-aid and fire-extinguisher provision as required for office occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Secretariat General of Taxation (SGT), Ministry of Finance, Sultanate of Oman; mandatory e-services, VAT returns, and invoicing clearance are operated through the Oman Tax Portal 'Taxoman' (apps.taxoman.gov.om / TMS e-Services).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Establish the Single Person Company (SPC) with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) through the integrated investor platform and obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) and municipal trade license; the CR embodies the foreign-investor registration approval. 2) File the statutory Tax Registration application on the Oman Tax Portal within 60 days of CR issuance, attaching the CR, SPC articles/constituent deed, foreign shareholder identity documents, power of attorney, local bank account certificate, and fiscal-domicile statement; the Secretariat General of Taxation issues the corporate Tax Identification Number (TIN). 3) Register for VAT through the same portal when actual or expected 12-month taxable supplies exceed OMR 500,000, or voluntarily once turnover exceeds OMR 38,500, and obtain the 15-digit VAT registration number and e-invoice account activation. 4) Onboard to the e-invoicing environment by certifying the XML invoice issuer profile and API/token credentials of the SPC's billing or ERP system. 5) Keep the SGT profile updated on shareholding, legal-form, fiscal-year, and invoice-issuing changes and archive all registration certificates for the statutory retention period.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the SPC is a resident juridical person taxed in its own name under the Omani corporate income tax regime, with chargeable profits assessed at the current Omani head rates (3% and 15% bands depending on taxable income). No pass-through election is available to the sole foreign shareholder. Oman applies a worldwide-profits scope to resident companies with relief for tax-paid foreign branch profits and participation-exempt foreign dividends; Omani-source patent-agency and trademark-prosecution fees remain within the domestic tax net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not operate a US-style check-the-box classification or OECD hybrid-mismatch election for single-member companies. Election rights available in the Oman tax framework for the SPC include: (i) choice of a non-calendar fiscal year with SGT approval; (ii) eligible election of depreciation/amortization methods for fixed and IP assets; (iii) participation-exemption election for qualifying foreign shareholdings subject to foreign tax; (iv) grouping election for VAT registration of related Omani legal persons under a single VAT account; (v) voluntary VAT registration election once taxable turnover exceeds OMR 38,500 and prior to reaching the mandatory OMR 500,000 threshold; and (vi) application for an Advance Pricing Arrangement or mutual agreement procedure to resolve transfer-pricing and double-tax exposure.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) imposed under Oman VAT Law (Royal Decree No. 121/2020) and its Executive Regulations, aligned with the unified GCC VAT Agreement.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration when taxable supplies in the preceding 12 months or expected next 12 months reach OMR 500,000; voluntary VAT registration when taxable supplies exceed OMR 38,500; for income tax, every incorporated SPC must obtain a TIN regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The SGT's national e-invoicing program is operational via the Taxoman platform. VAT-registered taxpayers must issue Arabic/English tax invoices in structured XML format carrying the 15-digit VAT number, unique sequential invoice identifier, date of supply, customer details, and the statutory zero-rating certificate wording where applicable. Taxpayers onboarded in SGT clearance waves transmit invoice datasets to the Taxoman portal in near real time through API/ERP integration and receive a digital clearance token or QR mark before issuance; taxable persons not yet onboarded remain subject to the standing invoice-data retention, monthly listing, and clearance-readiness duties. Non-compliant invoice architecture may void the documentary defense of a zero-rated export in audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically removed from Oman to a destination outside the GCC are zero-rated; services qualify for zero-rating where the purchaser is a non-resident outside the GCC, the benefit is wholly received and enjoyed outside the Sultanate, and the services do not relate to land, goods located in Oman, or an Omani recipient. For the SPC's core business, international PCT patent prosecution, trademark registration, and foreign IP renewal services satisfy the zero-rating test where the client is a foreign non-GCC principal, the filings are made at overseas intellectual-property registries, and the rights are not exploited in Oman. Intra-GCC supplies to clients resident in another GCC state remain subject to the normal place-of-supply VAT rules and cannot be zero-rated as exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Bayan) lodged through the Oman Customs National Single Window/Bayangate showing the export procedure code, HS classification, quantity, and non-GCC destination
Transport document evidencing physical exit from Oman: ocean Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or international CMR road waybill
Zero-rated VAT tax invoice, in Arabic/English, carrying the SPC's 15-digit VAT number and the statement 'zero-rated export supply under the Oman VAT Law'

Inward remittance evidence: SWIFT MT103/MT202 credit advice, bank statement entry, or Inward Remittance Certificate from the Omani receiving bank matching the commercial invoice and foreign principal's identity

Service completion file replacing the customs transcript for pure IP services: signed engagement contract, PCT/foreign trademark filing receipts, power-of-attorney docket, and foreign registry correspondence proving delivery and beneficial enjoyment of the supply outside Oman
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SGT audit performs bill-level reconciliation of zero-rated claims against Bayangate manifests, shipping track-and-trace records, freight forwarder certifications, foreign-registry filing confirmations, bank payment flows, and FX repatriation within the 180-day administrative benchmark. Incomplete or contradictory export files cause reversal of the 0% rate, re-assessment at 5% VAT, monthly statutory late-payment surcharge from the original return due date, and imposed administrative fines per defective invoice (commonly OMR 1,000–10,000). Deliberate fabrication of export or foreign-receipt evidence is treated as VAT evasion, triggering retrospective clawbacks across open assessment periods, fines up to OMR 25,000 in aggravated cases, imprisonment, public listing of the taxpayer, and disqualification of the foreign client's input-credit position in Oman.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) - established under Royal Decree 7/1974 and governed by the Banking Law promulgated by Royal Decree 114/2000 - is the licensing, supervisory, and monetary authority for all banks and payment institutions in the Sultanate of Oman. The CBO administers the Omani Rial (OMR) peg to the US Dollar, supervises the Muscat Clearing House and national payment rails, and receives BPM6 balance-of-payments and foreign-exchange transaction reports from all licensed commercial banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial is fully convertible on both current and capital accounts under Oman's IMF Article VIII obligations and the Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree 50/2019). The CBO maintains a de jure peg of 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD, with commercial banks quoting narrow dealing spreads around parity and the CBO defending the rate in the interbank market. For this PCT prosecution agency: (a) current-account payments - PCT international fees, trademark office fees, WIPO annuities, and disbursements to foreign associates - require no prior CBO approval and clear freely through licensed banks; (b) capital-account flows - equity injection into the SPC, shareholder loans, dividend repatriation, and liquidation proceeds - are lawful but must be classified under BPM6 direct-investment codes and evidenced with documentation retained for ten years under the AML/CFT Law (Royal Decree 30/2016). Profit-remittance hurdles are documentary only: the SPC must produce audited financial statements and a tax-clearance certificate from the Oman Tax Authority, and must settle or treaty-relieve the 10% dividend withholding tax imposed by the Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009) before the outward dividend wire is released. No other convertibility restriction, currency rationing, or approval gate exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Oman imposes no export-proceeds surrender deadline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export receipts or cross-border service revenues. The SPC may retain 100% of foreign-currency income in a CBO-licensed USD/EUR/GBP account, convert only the OMR tranche required for local operating expenditure, and apply the remaining balance directly to USD-denominated patent-office payments. The receiving bank is required only to record each inflow under the applicable BPM6 trade-in-services classification for legal and IP advisory services and, where the remittance reaches the SPC through a fintech intermediary, to preserve the signed engagement contract, payer identification data, and payment-method trail supporting the underlying transaction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Share Capital Escrow Account (pre-commercial-registration deposit) plus multi-currency Operational Account (OMR, USD, EUR, GBP) with corporate internet banking and SWIFT MT103 origination
Operational Current Account (OMR/USD) with sweep facility and cross-border payment desk for SME exporters of services
Operational Current Account with Falcon corporate digital banking and dedicated enterprise unit for licensed professional-services firms
Global Operational Account with USD concentration, same-day OMR/USD conversion, and direct MT103 connectivity to WIPO, EPO, and foreign correspondent banks
SME Operational Account and term-deposit collateral for working-capital and bank-guarantee facilities
Operational Current Account with trade-finance desk ancillary to professional-fee disbursements
Islamic Current Account - structurally incompatible with conventional interest-bearing escrow, FX forwards, and swap documentation

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium - legally viable only as a supplementary disbursement rail, never as the primary treasury or settlement account. Wise Business (UK FCA-authorised EMI) and similar offshore digital EMIs cannot hold OMR, deploy OMR clearing, or issue Omani IBANs without a CBO payment-institution licence under the National Payment Systems Law; hence all client receipts must ultimately settle into a licensed Omani bank account to satisfy the SPC's commercial registration, VAT, and statutory-audit obligations. Wise is operationally attractive for low-value (under USD 10,000) official-fee payments to WIPO, USPTO, EPO, and CNIPA owing to embedded FX conversion and reachability to SEPA, Fedwire, CHATS, and CIPS local rails, but the SPC must maintain a dual-control approval matrix, a pre-approved beneficiary registry, monthly reconciliation sub-ledgers, and must route the capital injection, dividend payments, and Oman Tax Authority payments exclusively through the Tier-1 bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical presence and in-person KYC/CDD interview of at least one director or an authorized Oman-resident signatory are mandatory at Bank Muscat, NBO, and Bank Dhofar for a 100% foreign-owned SPC. HSBC Bank Oman permits a hybrid remote-onboarding path: the foreign UBO may complete a video interview provided a notarized and attested Power of Attorney to an Oman-resident manager is lodged together with the certified Commercial Registration (Sijil), Chamber of Commerce certificate, and UBO source-of-wealth declaration. A fully remote opening with no local nexus is not available under current CBO-compliant practice; the recommended route is a two-day Muscat visit for biometric capture, original passport and CR verification, and execution of the banking agreement, followed by fully remote day-to-day treasury operations via corporate digital banking.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% foreign-owned SPC with a sole non-resident UBO located outside the GCC and no staff or office at the registered address at the time of onboarding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled/attested passport and residential-address proof of the UBO; MOCIIP Commercial Registration (Sijil) and Oman Chamber of Commerce membership certificate; certified Arabic translation of the SPC constitutive documents; board resolution appointing the Oman-resident manager; manager's Omani ID and residence permit; audited financial statements and bank reference letter of the foreign shareholder; independent source-of-wealth declaration and negative-news report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or intermediate shareholder is tax-resident in a FATF grey-list or high-risk jurisdiction, or is a corporate vehicle with no evident economic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) file containing the FATF mutual-evaluation extract for the relevant jurisdiction; UBO corporate-registry extract, register of directors, and group-structure chart; tax-residency certificate and economic-substance declaration; source-of-funds trail (sale proceeds, dividends, or loan) traced through 12-month bank statements; internal AML-committee memorandum approving the relationship under CBO omnibus requirements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Service-income profile inconsistent with conventional goods trade: recurring high-value legal-agency invoices and frequent outgoing wires to foreign patent offices, trademark agents, and national IP registries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete patent-prosecution engagement file: signed client representation agreements; WIPO PCT transmittal forms; official invoices from WIPO, EPO, USPTO, CNIPA, and national offices; detailed fee sub-ledger mapping each outgoing wire to a specific application or registration number; Oman 5% VAT returns proving the services classification; consequential reconciliation to the firm's statutory audit trail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring incoming wires from fintech aggregators (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) or third-party payment service providers, presenting pass-through layering flags in the bank's transaction-monitoring system.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the SPC's direct commercial agreement with the EMI; EMI licence or FCA-equivalent explanatory letter; per-client payment reconciliation with payer identification data; standard operating procedure capping EMI usage at USD 10,000 per remittance and requiring immediate onward settlement to the Omani operational account; monthly dual-control compliance review log listing every EMI transaction.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registration (CR) Annual Renewal - Annual Return Equivalent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP), Commercial Registry Department, via the Meras/Invest Easy portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the CR expiry/anniversary date shown on the registration certificate; renewal applications accepted during the 30 days preceding expiry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 10 per month late-renewal surcharge; CR suspended after failure to renew by the anniversary; continuous non-renewal beyond approximately 6 months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the SPC

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements - Preparation, Independent Audit and Sole-Member Approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Certified external auditor and the SPC sole member; audited accounts retained at the registered office and submitted to the Oman Tax Authority in support of the CIT return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the financial year (typically 30 April for a 31 December year-end); accounts must be approved in a sole-member resolution and signed before the CIT return is filed by the 30 June statutory filing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint an auditor or produce audited accounts: administrative fines under the Commercial Companies Law (commonly OMR 500-1,000); the Oman Tax Authority may reject the CIT return, disregard unaudited accounts and assess tax on a best-known/inference basis

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Return and Tax Clearance Certificate Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) - Income Tax Assessment Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months from the end of the accounting/tax year (30 June for a 31 December year-end); OTA may grant an extension upon written application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: 25% of the tax due in respect of the first 3 months after the due date, rising to 35% thereafter; income understatement: additional 30% of the extra tax; unpaid tax accrues monthly interest at approximately 1%; issuance of the OTA tax clearance certificate is blocked until all returns and payments are settled, which in turn prevents CR renewal

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOCIIP - Beneficial Ownership Register (filed digitally through the Meras/investor portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days following the CR anniversary; intermediate updates required within 15 days of any share transfer, change in control, or change in ultimate beneficial owner
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines from OMR 100 up to OMR 1,000 per non-compliant period under the MOCIIP Beneficial Ownership Regulations (Decision 249/2019); repeated non-confirmation leads to CR suspension and blocked renewal of the operating license

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent Omani municipality (e.g., Muscat Municipality), Licensing Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the municipal license expiry date, which in practice coincides with the CR anniversary; renewal must be lodged through the municipal one-stop shop before the expiry date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily fines for operating with an expired municipal license; municipal closure notice for unlicensed operation; the municipality withholds the clearance approval required for CR renewal, effectively halting all commercial activity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) Annual Membership Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) - Membership and Subscription Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in conjunction with the CR renewal; a valid OCCI membership certificate is a pre-condition for the MOCIIP CR renewal decision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of membership prevents CR renewal, notarization/legalization of company documents and issuance of certificates of origin; reinstatement is subject to payment of arrears and re-subscription fees

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size or turnover exemption applies to a standard Omani SPC: every limited-liability company, including a single-person company, must appoint a licensed external auditor and obtain audited financial statements for each financial year under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019); the small-business CIT relief for annual revenue not exceeding OMR 30,000 (Royal Decree 53/2017) does not waive the Companies Law audit mandate
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; the Commercial Companies Law (R.D. 18/2019) prescribes preparation of financial statements under IFRS, with local disclosure conventions applied where formats require adaptation; financial statements must be in Arabic or accompanied by a certified Arabic translation

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: For a 100% foreign-owned or locally owned SPC, the sole member's identity and the ultimate natural-person beneficial ownership chain must be re-submitted and re-confirmed once every 12-month period through the MOCIIP Meras portal, coinciding with the CR anniversary. Any transfer of shares, change in ownership structure, or change in ultimate control must be lodged with the Beneficial Ownership Register within 15 days and recorded in the physical Register of Members and UBO folder on the same business day. The confirmation comprises a full beneficial ownership statement (full name, nationality, national ID/passport number, residential address, percentage of ownership or control, and date of qualification) and must remain permanently accessible for inspection by the commercial registry, tax authority and law-enforcement agencies.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (recording the sole member and all share transfers, linked to the UBO statement)
Register of Directors/Manager (appointment, removal, powers and indemnities)
Minute Book (sole-member resolutions, management decisions and general assembly minutes)
Register of Charges (pledges, mortgages and encumbrances over company assets)
Register of Company Seals and Share Certificates

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 - 1,200 per annum for a Muscat registered-office and corporate-service provider (includes registered address, CR renewal handling, statutory register maintenance and UBO filing assistance; in-person legal representation services may add USD 300 - 600)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 900 - 2,500 per annum for a low-revenue IP patent and trademark prosecution SPC (typical 5-8 certified auditor partner hours, preparation of Arabic financial statements and statutory audit report, excluding transfer-pricing documentation where cross-border related-party transactions exist)
